event.relevance_rationale: The article details the continued closure of the Strait of Hormuz and recent attacks on commercial vessels in key maritime transit routes (Bab el-Mandeb and Gulf of Oman), directly disrupting global shipping and supply chains relevant to PSA container operations.
event.summary: Iran declared that the Strait of Hormuz will remain closed to shipping until the US accepts its conditions. Meanwhile, recent attacks on vessels in the Gulf of Oman and the Bab el-Mandeb strait highlight persistent operational hazards to maritime trade across major Middle Eastern transit corridors.
evidence: The Strait of Hormuz will remain closed as long as the US does not change its behaviour and accept Iran’s conditions to end the war
Adding to the rhetoric from both sides were reports of new attacks on shipping in the Gulf of Oman and the Red Sea, highlighting the threat to maritime trade.
Four crew members were killed in a suspected attack by Yemen’s Iran-backed Houthis on a small cargo vessel in the Bab el-Mandeb strait on Aug 11
